newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip across the board.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Thursday, pressured by weaker prices in rubber producing countries, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.7 yen to 2.7 yen per kg lower. Benchmark March was 2.5 yen lower at 134.0 yen.
The market started the day on an easier tone, and sentiment was further dampened after benchmark March broke through the recent low of 135.4 yen per kg marked on August 12.
"Sentiment turned bearish technically after the benchmark March fell below the recent low. We think the bearish tone will continue for some time," one trader said.
